{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans support a healthy intercity passenger rail system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Amtrak provides a valuable service to passengers, especially in the Northeast corridor.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The goal of establishing a national passenger rail system with modest federal support has failed to materialize.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The financial problems plaguing Amtrak cannot be solved simply by continued infusions of taxpayer dollars.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Fundamental reforms should be enacted to transition Amtrak into operational self-sufficiency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A stable, affordable, more independent energy supply is vital to fueling America's economic growth, increasing prosperity, helping families afford prices at the pump, and making America more secure.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Bush and Republicans in Congress recognize the need for a balanced energy policy that increases both energy production and conservation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A comprehensive energy policy is needed so that the United States will no longer lurch from one energy crisis to the next.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Recent electricity blackouts, the California energy crisis, natural gas and oil price spikes, and high gasoline prices remind us that only a comprehensive energy policy will produce energy stability for America's families and businesses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
